title: Tracks never played
statementMd:
How many tracks have never been played?

Expected columns: `never_played`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS never_played FROM tracks t LEFT JOIN plays p ON p.track_id = t.id WHERE p.id IS NULL;
```
